explanation: Under Section 22 of the RBI Act, the Reserve Bank of India has the sole right to issue currency notes of all denominations except one-rupee notes and coins, which are issued by the Ministry of Finance.
RBI issues currency, regulates the financial system, and manages foreign exchange. Personal income tax rates are determined by the Central Government/Ministry of Finance.
The cheque number is represented by a 6-digit sequence printed at the bottom of the cheque.
